name: Counting Breaths
description: Count five breaths, one at a time, then count them once more.
author: Lullshift

help.summary: Count five breaths, twice, on Breathing Space.
help.goal: There is nothing to finish. Losing count is fine; just start again.
howToPlay: Press Begin when you are ready.
Breathe in as the shape grows and say the number in your head.
Breathe out as it shrinks. The words on screen tell you which count you are on.
tips: Breathe in a way that feels easy. If anything feels uncomfortable, stop and breathe normally.
